indication: adjunctive treatment of partial seizures with or without secondary generalisation in adolescents and children aged 6 years and above
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food

dosage_frequency: twice a day || three times a day
mechanism_of_action: anti-epileptic drug with multiple mechanisms of action and a structure which is chemically unrelated to any other AED
